title: RX-V1 producer leg: no operator channel to grant acknowledge_* in a live dispatch
wanted_capability: A per-dispatch, operator-controlled way to inject `default:<tool>.<param>=true` entries into the ToolArgDefaults map a harness child loads (e.g. ExecParams.tool_defaults, a brofile `env`/defaults field, or a named grant profile). Verified absent: MCP bro_exec has no such field; /control/exec ExecParams has none; Brofile has no env field; fleet.json shell_env reaches shell grandchildren only, not the agent loop; account env technically merges but is credential-scoped. Design section 8.2 rejected a dedicated dispatch field assuming "dispatch config" existed; it does not, so every RX-V1 consumer (rust.moveStructFields, rust.migrateErrorType, rust.migrateTypeUsages) can only refuse inside a real dispatch today.
missing_primitive: Operator-facing per-dispatch tool_arg_defaults delivery (ExecParams field, brofile env, or equivalent)
fallback_used: isolate --tool-defaults CLI flag for probes; live dispatches have no channel and any RX-V1 tool call in a dispatch refuses.
